# XVcache

> Local MCP server (STDIO) that journals reads and writes in a Markdown vault as a sha256-chained JSONL log. Verdicts: V (intacte), X (MODIFIÉE hors XVcache). Slogan: J'ai caché, j'ai prouvé. First customer: the AI agent. Payment is not live. Prices in the catalog are placeholders marked TBD.

This repository has not been published yet (no GitHub repo, no npm release, no directory listing).

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): when to propose XVcache to a human, how to request approval for paid use, reseller/partner notes (terms TBD)
- [README.md](./README.md): pitch, quickstart, client config, V then X demo, limits
- [docs/TOOLS.md](./docs/TOOLS.md): MCP tool contract
- [plans.json](./plans.json): machine-readable plans (free, usage-based, monthly bundles). All prices TBD.

## Code

- [src/server.ts](./src/server.ts): MCP tools over STDIO
- [src/journal.ts](./src/journal.ts): journal format, chain verify, V/X wording
- [src/plans.ts](./src/plans.ts): catalog, recommend_plan, request_upgrade stub, certify_note stub
- [src/verify-journal.ts](./src/verify-journal.ts): CLI for the JSONL chain
- [server.json](./server.json): official MCP Registry metadata template (`io.github.xvcache/xvcache`)

## Tools (MCP)

Journal, available now: `read_note`, `search_notes`, `write_note`, `verify_journal`.

Buy / certify / resell, stubs except the catalog: `get_offer`, `list_plans`, `recommend_plan`, `request_upgrade` (human approval, Stripe intended, not live; x402 later), `certify_note` (witness certification à venir).

Env: `XVCACHE_VAULT` (required), `XVCACHE_LOG` (optional, outside the vault). Aliases: `JAYCACHE_VAULT`, `JAYCACHE_LOG`.
